name: t3-watch
description: Monitoring that sets itself up from the projects on your machine and wakes your coding agent only when something changes. Checks for CI, sites and APIs, cloud accounts, API-key vendors and scheduled jobs run as plain code on Watch's own clock; the agent investigates failures, leaves notes and drafts new checks. Needs the Watch service running locally (`t3-watch install`); `npx @lfg-labs/t3-watch demo` tries it on sample data.
author: sami-abdul
